feeds.title: FreshRN Blog
feeds.description: Kati Kleber, MSN RN is a nurse educator, author, national speaker, host of the FreshRN Podcast, and owner of FreshRN - an online platform created to educate, encourage, and motivate newly licensed nurses in innovative ways.

feeds.title: Nurse Nacole
feeds.description: Nacole Riccaboni is a board-certified registered nurse, blogs about advanced nursing education and being a new nurse. She posts daily nursing tips, bedside nursing resources, practices, along with advice on nursing academics, licensing exams, professionalism, and nursing school success.

feeds.title: Minority Nurse Blog
feeds.description: Minority Nurse Magazine provides resources and information pertaining to education, career development, and minority health for the ever-increasing number of minority nurses in America.

feeds.title: The Nurse Speak Blog
feeds.description: Nurse education consultant here to help nursing students, nursing assistant students, new graduate RNs and professional nurses meet their academic and/or learning needs through individualized consultation services.

feeds.title: Ignite:Nursing Education
feeds.description: Ignite was established to support the 21st-century teaching and learning needs within the nursing classroom and on the job. Ignite believes in supporting the continuum of the nursing development, from class to floor, and we are passionate about sharing curriculum and evaluation development tips, strategies for success, fun technologically enhanced teaching and learning tools, and news on today's nursing climate.

feeds.title: BMJ Blogs » Nurse Education
feeds.description: Explore our analysis and discussion of developments in Evidence-Based Nursing. BMJ Journals is a collection of more than 70 medical and allied science titles. They are published by BMJ, the global healthcare knowledge provider and pioneer in the development of open access.

feeds.title: Stanbridge University Blog » Nursing
feeds.description: Stanbridge University is an award-winning institution that offers programs in Nursing and Allied Health. Check out our tips and resources for nursing curriculum and students, news and more!

feeds.title: Nursing Education Network
feeds.description: This educational website is created by nurses specifically for nurse educators. Education theory, simulation, research and social media are part of this e-learning experience. The aim is to create a resource for nurses to access, share and develop a learning community using open-access resources.

feeds.title: Arizona College of Nursing Blog
feeds.description: Our focused and structured, culturally rich, and dynamic learning environment fosters faculty, staff, and student engagement. Explore our campus life news, students' insights, nursing school programs and more!

feeds.title: Top Nurse Blog
feeds.description: Top Nurse Info provides all the possible information related to the CNA. All these blogs posts are written with extensive research and you can be sure that you will get very useful information on the entire characteristics of a cna job

feeds.title: Nursing Education Expert Blog
feeds.description: Nursing Education Expert provides nursing students, practicing nurses, and other healthcare professionals with high-quality, evidence-based information, education, and advice. Find the current blog post, podcasts and videos for Nursing Education Expert here.

feeds.title: NursingCAS Blog
feeds.description: NursingCAS is the nation's only centralized application service for students applying to nursing programs at all levels. Similar to services in place for medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, and other health professions, NursingCAS offers students a convenient way to research and apply to multiple nursing programs with a single online application. Learn more about nursing applications, tips, advice and more!

feeds.title: Pride Nursing Education Blog
feeds.description: Providing quality nursing education that supports nurses in any stage of their career, is aimed to encourage critical thinking over rote memorization, and create a space where nurses can become more confident to better care for the patients. Check out the latest news and updates, resources and more!

feeds.title: Wild Iris Medical Education Blog » Nursing Education
feeds.description: Get information about free nursing CEUs online, learning about diseases and conditions.CE Broker and other reporting information, nurses week and more. Wild Iris Medical Education, Inc., provides high-quality online continuing education courses for nurses, occupational therapists and occupational therapy assistants (OT/OTA), physical therapists and physical therapy assistants (PT/PTA), paramedics, EMTs, and other healthcare professionals.

feeds.title: Nursing Times » Education and Training
feeds.description: Check out the latest nursing education news, including clinical, opinion, analysis, and debate. Nursing Times is the independent voice of nursing. We educate, inform and support the nursing profession through our award-winning peer-reviewed journal, online learning resources and website. We celebrate nurses' achievements through our awards.

feeds.title: Nurse.com Blog » Nursing education
feeds.description: Nurse.com is the leading source of nursing jobs, local and national nurse news, and continuing nursing education with free CEs and webinars. To enrich the professional lives of nurses and other healthcare professionals and to celebrate their unique contributions to society.

feeds.title: All Nursing Schools
feeds.description: This blog provides information about nursing careers and degrees to help prospective students make decisions about their education. All Nursing Schools is committed to helping you advance your career and improve your life through education. It's our mission to empower you on your career path by being a trusted resource for information that will help you achieve your goal for a better future.
